description.zh: 查 IT 工单、看常见故障的自助排障提示、新建工单。连的是 dsh-ee 自带的示例工单系统。
description.en: Look up IT tickets, read self-service tips for common faults, and open a ticket. Talks to the sample ticket system that ships with dsh-ee.

description.zh: 工单概况：未解决、超过 3 天没解决、近 7 天解决的各有多少张。先用它看全貌，再决定要不要查明细。
description.en: Ticket overview: how many are open, overdue (open for more than 3 days) and resolved in the last 7 days. Start here before listing tickets.

description.zh: 只看某人报修的，填姓名
description.en: Only tickets opened by this person (full name)

description.zh: 新建一张 IT 工单。这是写操作：调用前先把标题、分类、现象和已经试过的排查步骤给员工确认。
description.en: Open an IT ticket. This writes data: confirm the title, category, symptoms and what was already tried with the employee first.

description.zh: 故障分类，拿不准先用 list_categories 看每一类的说明
description.en: Fault category; call list_categories first if unsure

label.zh: Agent 新建的工单用什么优先级
label.en: Priority for tickets opened by the agent
